source: docs/design/fable-review-2026-11-19/03-classes-plan.md section 3.5 D1 Fire, Normal (the recommended first Druid build); docs/classes/druid.md section 1 and 3 (Maxroll Druid leveling, V: Firestorm 1-5, Molten Boulder 6-7, Firestorm 8-11, Fissure from 12); the shipped druid_fire_normal30 table
notes: No respec (the Maxroll respec to Tornado and Hurricane at clvl 38 is not used: both are unsupported rows). Fissure is Eruption in skills.txt. Firestorm to 5, Molten Boulder 2 (the prerequisite of Eruption), Firestorm to 9, Eruption from clvl 12; Oak Sage at 16 for a tanking spirit, Arctic Blast and Cyclone Armor 1 each as the cheap absorb (the engine casts Cyclone Armor from its buff ladder), Eruption to 10, Volcano 1 at 24 (V skills.txt: reqlevel 24, needs Eruption; cast by no band yet), then Molten Boulder, Firestorm and Eruption to 20. Shapeshift skills, Tornado, Hurricane and Armageddon are NOT in this file (unsupported rows). Stats: Vitality to 75 (clvl 2 to 11), Strength to 25 (12, 13), Vitality to 115 (14 to 21), Strength to 50 (22 to 26), the rest Vitality (V Maxroll, U that 26 and later fit a bot).
